name: How long does handrail repair usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does handrail repair usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of handrail repair depends on the scope of the damage. Simple repairs like tightening loose connections or minor cosmetic fixes can often be completed within a few hours to a single day. More complex repairs involving material fabrication, significant structural work, or extensive finishing may take several days. We provide an estimated timeline with your quote.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple repairs take hours to a day; complex repairs can take several days. We provide a timeline with your quote.
